silhouette.reason: Reads as a big furry quadruped, but the long narrow snout, small head and long low trunk read wolverine/badger or canid more than bear in hero.png and SIDE; the shoulder hump is weak.
fixes: shorten and widen the muzzle and enlarge the head ~15% so the dished bear face reads
raise the shoulder hump mass and shorten the trunk so the back slopes from hump to rump

proportions.reason: 2.3 × 0.7 × 1.2 m matches the declared adult male envelope, but within it the neck is long, the head small and the hind legs stretched back like a dog's stance.
fixes: shorten the neck chain and bring the hind feet under the hips (plantigrade stance)

materials.reason: Fur cards on the back and a dark-leg gradient read as fur at distance; the face and lower body are smooth painted vertex colour with one roughness.
fixes: extend the fur cards over the flanks and face edge so the coat is continuous
roughness split: glossy nose and eyes, rough coat

detail.reason: Claws, nose, eyes, fur fringe on the spine; no fur clumps on the belly or legs, ear and face planes soft.
fixes: longer fur fringe on the belly and back of the forelegs
sharper brow and cheek planes; thicker, rounder ears

wear.reason: Clean: no mud, no wet fur, no scars.
fixes: mud on the paws and lower legs (grime with the ground mask)
seeded scars and a rubbed patch on the shoulder

lod.reason: LOD2 (1.8k) keeps the outline but is heavily faceted, loses the fur fringe and the legs become thin tubes.
fixes: keep a coarse fur fringe on the back at LOD2 (a few cards)
LOD2 legs from the sculpt with an inflate instead of tubes

technical.reason: QA PASS; 160.9k / 29.4k / 1.8k triangles; 2 draws. LOD0 is heavy for a game creature and much of it is fur cards on the back.
fixes: cap LOD0 near 100k by coarsening the fur-card density on the back
